Take care of the legend

```{r}
# Exemple simulé si tu n’as pas défini `simul_data`
set.seed(123)
simul_data <- data.frame(
  x = rnorm(90),
  y = rnorm(90),
  colored = rep(names(list_irfs_demand), each = 30)
  # ,
  # `Identification` = rep(c("Cholesky", "IV"), 50)
)

# Définir le mapping manuel pour les types de traits
#linetype <- c("Cholesky" = "dashed", "IV" = "solid")

# Plot avec légende uniquement
# Plot avec légende uniquement
plot_legend <- ggplot(data = simul_data, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = y, color = colored))+#, bins = 30, alpha = 0.6) +
  #geom_line(aes(y = y)) +#, linetype = `Identification`)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Raw" ="blue" ,   "Residualized"="red" ,      "PCA" = "green" ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  # scale_linetype_manual(
  #   values = linetype,
  #   name = "Identification",
  #   drop = FALSE
  # ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16)
  )
# Extraire la légende personnalisée
#custom_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_legend)
#custom_legend <- get_plot_component(plot_legend, "guide-box", return_all = TRUE)[[3]]
custom_legend <- get_legend(plot_legend)
#custom_legend[[3]]

```
